answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 7512 Country: United States of America Title: Can one comb their hair after magrib? Is it allowed to clean ones ear with a qutip/bud? Question: Can one comb their hair after magrib? Is it allowed to clean ones ear with a qutip/bud? Answer ID: 7512 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 907/907=M/1429) Yes, one can do so; there is nothing wrong as per the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
